name: Starter sensor mount
alignment_method: Rigid least-squares alignment of four bore axes to mount_hole_candidates.json. Source X points forward, source Y points up, and source Z points toward negative hand Y; the mount is centered on the reference side-plane midpoint. Geometry is not rescaled beyond millimetres to metres.
fit_note: Bore axes agree within 0.046 mm in the model. This is a numerical fit, not a claim of physical accuracy. The supplied STL has a 78 mm inner opening versus 84 mm between accessory-derived reference planes; retained lower-jaw geometry in the approximate preview may overlap its side plates. Verify on the physical gripper.
